name: 科技布羽绒大靠包软包床款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒立住「软包大床加羽绒大靠包」的卧室主视觉，用真实卧室与可躺靠的铺法让人代入自己的主卧。
shots.textZone: 右上留白：橄榄小方块标签「{callout_1}」，两行主标题「{selling_point_1}」，其下一行细字「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 干净的白底单品主图，一次看清床头比例、床体厚度与脚型，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
shots.textZone: 画面内不渲染文字，仅右下角一枚骨白小方卡「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把源页的六项选择理由排成一眼可读的宫格，一次交代面料、填充、框架、承托与脚型的整体配置逻辑。
shots.textZone: 顶部 #4A5741 色带主标「{selling_point_2}」；六格各一枚方框图标与短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 同机位分屏放大「薄硬床头靠半小时就腰酸、枕头乱滑」的真实睡前痛点，逼出大靠包需求。
shots.textZone: 顶部 #4A5741 色带一行主标「{selling_point_3}」，两格底角各一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 正侧 90 度剖面把头、背、腰三处承托位置一次标清，把「靠感」这类抽象卖点变成可见结构证据。
shots.textZone: 右带三枚橄榄方标签自上而下「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，各以 1px 引线连到对应承托位；顶部主标「{selling_point_4}」

shots.intent: 微距交代面料织面、纹理走向与封边缝线的做工一致性，把材质与耐久疑虑落到可见证据上。
shots.textZone: 下方留白带：小标题「{selling_point_5}」与其下一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，1px 橄榄引线指向缝线

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把床体底部的排布结构、边轨与落地脚一次看清，用可见结构而不是形容词回应承重与稳固焦虑。
shots.textZone: 底部两枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，以 1px 橄榄引线分别连到脚柱与床板边轨

shots.intent: 把源页的五对五品质对照改成通用可替换的对照双卡，让买家在同类比价时一眼看到差异结构。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_6}」；左卡标题「{callout_1}」配五行打勾短标签「{callout_2}」，右卡标题「{callout_3}」配五行打叉短标签「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用四项凭证位与一张通用规格表把「有报告、有参数」摊开，以透明结构而不是空洞口号降低决策风险。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；四枚方框图标各配短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」；下方五行通用规格表，行名为通用词、数值一律为占位符「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 把源页的「潮流多色自由搭配」做成同款多配色并排，让买家先按自家卧室色调选定配色再谈尺寸。
shots.textZone: 每个变体底缘一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，同一条对齐基线

shots.intent: 把源页的推荐搭配落成一张真实卧室成套实景，用同系柜体与地毯给出人体尺度并带动连带选购。
shots.textZone: 左下角一列四枚橄榄小方标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」，顶部一行主标「{selling_point_8}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位的收紧中景把整页情绪落回睡前靠一靠的日常，再给一个明确的咨询选型动作。
shots.textZone: 下方四分之一 #4A5741 色带：主标「{selling_point_1}」，其下一枚方角按钮，填色 #7C8F6A，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real bedroom with a matte lime-washed plaster wall #E6EBDE over a honed pale stone-look floor #D6DBD0 with one soft wool-look rug #E4E8DC; a seamless cool mint studio sweep #EFF2E9 or pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, the underside structure screen and the colourway lineup; and one flat olive graphic board #7C8F6A carrying bone-white square panels #F7F8F3 closed by one deep-olive header strip #4A5741 for the feature grid, comparison, trust and specification layouts; every layout panel is square-cornered with one notched tab, one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: olive-green upholstered-bed commerce, garden-fresh graphic studio system with square-notched tiles and stacked block headlines rather than airy nordic daylight rooms, charcoal copy bands, warm zen interiors or porcelain-and-persimmon textile editorial
style.iconSystem: 2px square-framed monoline pictograms with the top-right corner notched away, drawn in #F7F8F3 inside solid olive #7C8F6A tiles and in #4A5741 on bone fields; step and list markers are solid deep-olive #4A5741 diamonds with #F7F8F3 numerals; callout leader lines are 1px solid olive closing on a 4px solid square, never a dot or a circle; check and cross glyphs are 2px square-outlined only; maximum six per screen; no hexagonal frames, no circular monoline pictograms, no filled discs, no square number chips with rounded corners, no corner-bracket photo frames, no seals, no 3D badges, no gradient fills
style.lightingSystem: even diffused light at 5400-5600K through one large overhead scrim entering from camera upper-right, with a low white bounce card at camera left opening up the shadow side; short dense contact shadow directly under the bed rails and legs, no long rakes, no window pools, no ceiling downlight ellipses, no warm lamp practical and no rear rim separation; macro screens add one low grazing band at the same 5500K travelling from camera right along the seam; this is deliberately NOT a 6500-7000K north-daylight wash, NOT a 4000-4300K interior with downlight pools, NOT a 3000-3200K lace-curtain lantern grade and NOT a 5000-5200K top-front softbox with a back rim
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent olive-green upholstered-bed ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mint layout white #EFF2E9, olive band #7C8F6A, deep olive #4A5741, bone card #F7F8F3 and ink-green text #2A2E27, with the product upholstery tone taken unchanged from the reference; neutral-cool grade; one mid-weight square-terminal Chinese grotesque family for both display and body, headlines stacked as two tight-tracked lines with no Latin eyebrow, no serif, no condensed and no heavy geometric display face, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short; backgrounds limited to a real bedroom with a matte lime-washed plaster wall #E6EBDE over a honed pale stone-look floor #D6DBD0 with one soft wool-look rug #E4E8DC, a seamless cool mint studio sweep #EFF2E9 or pure white #FFFFFF for packshot, underside and colourway screens, and one flat olive board #7C8F6A carrying bone square panels #F7F8F3 closed by a deep-olive header strip #4A5741, every panel square-cornered with one notched tab and one clean copy zone; lighting always even diffused 5400-5600K through one large overhead scrim entering from camera upper-right with a low white bounce at camera left, short dense contact shadow under rails and legs, no window pools, no ceiling downlight ellipses, no warm practical lamp, no rear rim, one low grazing band at 5500K on macro screens; surface system of matte lime-washed plaster, honed pale stone floor, cool matte linen bedding #DDE3D6, bone ceramic, matte olive lacquer and deep-olive graphic fields, the product rendered exactly as supplied with a matte face and no vinyl or patent gloss; icon system of 2px square-framed pictograms with a notched top-right corner, solid deep-olive diamond step markers with pale numerals, 1px olive leader lines closing on a 4px solid square and 2px square-outlined check and cross glyphs, maximum six per screen, no hexagons, no circles, no filled discs, no corner brackets and no seals; product presentation rules: identical scale, identical headboard panel division and top roll, identical loose head-cushion count and plumpness, identical side rails, seam lines, platform slat layout and leg form in every frame, grounded by real contact shadow, corrected straight verticals, one real furnishing as human scale anchor, the slight 3/4 mattress-height opening angle reused tightened on the closing screen; no color palette changes, no recoloured upholstery, no restyled headboard, no invented storage box or footboard, no mixed fonts, no rounded cards, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented dimensions, densities, timber species, board grades, eco grades, test reports or certificates, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges, no prices, no people.
noDrift: no 6500K north-daylight wash, no 4200K downlight pools, no 3000K lantern grade and no top-front softbox with rear rim replacing the 5400-5600K scrim key from camera upper-right
no recoloured, re-woven or re-grained upholstery, no vinyl or patent-leather gloss
no restyled headboard: panel division, top roll, cushion count and seam lines stay exactly as supplied
no invented storage box, gas lift, footboard, drawer, tufting, buttons, piping, carving or extra leg
no mixed fonts, no Latin eyebrow line, no serif and no condensed display face
no rounded cards, no random backgrounds
no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing ground shadow and no contradictory shadow lengths
no hexagonal, circular or bracket-frame icon styles
no invented dimensions, mattress size, foam density, down fill weight, timber species, board grade, load rating, eco grade, test report, award or certificate stated as fact
no brand mark, no store or company self-name, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price, no contact details
no people, no hands and no visible faces; any reused figure must be anonymous and cropped
style.presentationRules: the bed keeps one proportional scale and one identity in every frame: the same headboard panel division and top roll, the same count and plumpness of the loose head cushions, the same upholstered side rails, the same seam lines, the same platform and slat layout, the same leg count, section and finish and the same upholstery tone taken unchanged from the reference; it stands on the floor on real contact shadows and never floats; headboard uprights, wall corners, rug edges and frame lines stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (nightstand, dresser, rug, bedside lamp shade) always anchors human scale; the slight 3/4 mattress-height angle of the opening screen is reused, tightened, on the closing screen so the set reads as one bedroom; full-bed views stay under 40 percent of the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte lime-washed plaster wall #E6EBDE, honed pale stone floor #D6DBD0, cool matte linen bedding #DDE3D6, bone ceramic #F7F8F3, matte olive lacquered nightstand #7C8F6A and deep-olive graphic fields #4A5741; the product renders exactly as supplied with a matte face, satin sheen only where the reference shows a slight sheen, real seam relief and no vinyl gloss, no patent leather and no plastic shine
style.typography: one mid-weight square-terminal Chinese grotesque family used for both display and body, headlines stacked as two tight-tracked lines in #2A2E27 on bone fields and in #F7F8F3 on olive fields, the same family at regular weight for labels and in tabular figures for step numerals; headline 28-38pt, sub-line 14-16pt, label 10-13pt, all Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and per-screen copy under 50 characters; no Latin uppercase eyebrow line, no serif, no brush calligraphy, no condensed face, no heavy bold geometric display face
